description: The ten communication-failure modes of the comms-failure paper, in three groups by what happened to a message. The reference taxonomy that other annotators map onto.

groups.name: Not read
groups.definition: A post was not read: what it established drops out of what a seat acts on.

groups.name: Not binding
groups.definition: A post never became a commitment the team shares.

groups.name: Never done
groups.definition: A commitment was believed and never carried out.

modes.name: Open-set decay
modes.definition: The post claims or redoes an item that an earlier post already settled: delivered, or held by another seat.

modes.name: Replacement re-does work
modes.definition: A seat that joined late claims or redoes work the log already holds.

modes.name: Belief without commitment
modes.definition: A hedged claim that is never made firm, or an ask addressed to a seat that nobody answers.

modes.name: Identity drift
modes.definition: Who speaks or who leads changes under one handle: the post speaks for another seat, or a second seat claims a role already held.

modes.name: Unattested action
modes.definition: The post claims an action (pushed, uploaded, paid, tests pass) that nothing on the board attests.

modes.name: Review of nothing
modes.definition: The post passes a review of an item whose result was never delivered.

modes.name: Closure before budget
modes.definition: The post ends the work (a pause, a sign-off, a last heartbeat) while items are still open.

modes.name: Capability not routed
modes.definition: The post asks for an action only another seat can take, and the work is never routed to that seat.
mast: FM-2.2 Fail to ask for clarification

modes.name: Step repetition
modes.definition: The post repeats an earlier post and adds nothing new.

modes.name: Heartbeat cost
modes.definition: A status post with no new information.
